purpose: Housekeeping registry that pins the scope of every dataset/family touched across the C3-external program, to prevent claim drift between gates. Descriptive; authoritative decision records remain the per-gate decision JSONs.

NSD_C3G.dataset: Natural Scenes Dataset (internal C3G state-geometry work)
NSD_C3G.role: Origin of the perception<->imagery geometry question; internal reference geometry.
NSD_C3G.authorizes: internal C3G geometry only; NOT an external imagery qualification.
NSD_C3G.claim_boundary: No imagery reliability claim; perception-side reference only.

DIR_natural.dataset: Deep Image Reconstruction (DIR), OpenNeuro ds001506 / Figshare
DIR_natural.modality: imagery of 10 memorized NATURAL image exemplars
DIR_natural.authorizes: nothing -- 0/3 subjects passed the conservative reliability gate (C3XA).
DIR_natural.claim_boundary: DIR does NOT support natural-image perception->imagery geometry. Exact-image / pixel-matched imagery family; distinct from GOD category imagery.

DIR_artificial.modality: imagery of 15 memorized ARTIFICIAL shape exemplars
DIR_artificial.authorizes: a restricted artificial-shape geometry pilot ONLY (clearly labelled RESTRICTED); NOT general C3XR; NOT natural-image geometry.
DIR_artificial.claim_boundary: Artificial synthetic shapes only. Not a natural-object claim.

GOD.dataset: Generic Object Decoding (GOD), OpenNeuro ds001246 v1.2.1 / Figshare 7387130 v6; Horikawa & Kamitani 2017 Nat Commun 8:15037
GOD.modality: natural-object CATEGORY imagery (imagine any exemplar of a cued object category)
GOD.authorizes: if qualified, ONLY a restricted future category-level geometry gate C3XR-CAT; NEVER exact-image / pixel-matched C3XR.
GOD.claim_boundary: CATEGORY-level (natural-object category) imagery and category-matched perception<->imagery ONLY. NEVER 'exact-image imagery' or 'pixel-matched'.

MindCaptioning.role: C3XB D2 fallback IF GOD fails (frozen before GOD outcomes)
MindCaptioning.authorizes: nothing yet; inspected only if GOD fails the C3XB gate.
MindCaptioning.claim_boundary: Do NOT inspect if GOD qualifies. Has its own cue-only confound to control.
